note: Eligibility is an engineering reading of the licence evidence, not legal advice. 'eligible' means the image rights are documented and permit commercial ML training for FilmLook; nothing else is downloaded.

datasets.name: BlueNeg: A 35mm Negative Film Dataset (ICCV 2025)
datasets.content: 491 real 35 mm colour-negative scans (16-bit DNG) with 8-bit positive previews, 398 scanned prints, 247 pseudo-ground-truth images; 30 test items withheld
datasets.film_stock_labels: verified by the owner's own records (meta.json film_type): Kodak Gold 100-5 (226), Fuji NPH400 (53), Fuji 400 (45), Kodak Gold 400-5 (38), Konica Super XG 100 (30), Kodak Gold 100 (25), Fuji 100 (23), Kodak Gold 400 (19), Kodak GA 100 5095 (16), others (16)
datasets.paired: negative + print for 398 items; not digital/film pairs
datasets.size: about 60 GB full; about 1 GB for previews + pseudo-GT + metadata

license.name: BlueNeg Data Set License v1.0 (custom, CC-BY-like, not CC-BY)
license.terms: academic and commercial use permitted; credit 'Copyrighted by Tien-Tsin Wong' required in any publication, reproduction, redistribution or derivative; citation requested

datasets.provenance: shot and scanned by the copyright holder (Tien-Tsin Wong), 1988-2002, one photographer; family and travel scenes
datasets.intended_usage: external real-film evaluation set with verified stock labels; blue-intact previews as clean references; blue-corrupted as a real deterioration family; never split, never mixed into synthetic training labels

datasets.name: DigitalFilm_dataset (mirror)
datasets.content: 5 ZIPs named by film stock (Kodak Aerochrome, E100, Gold 200, ...); CycleGAN training data; ~7K images
datasets.real_film: film-side images are 'collected from the Internet' (card); digital side from a Xiaomi 13 Ultra and an HDR dataset

license.name: MIT (HF tag)
license.evidence: tag only; the card states film samples were collected from the Internet, so the image rights are unknown

datasets.commercial_ml_training: not permitted (no rights to the film images)

datasets.name: OpenPhoto Restore Dataset
datasets.content: 4,500 train + 500 test pairs: pristine 1024x1024 digital photo vs procedurally damaged copy (cracks, scratches, sepia, Gaussian 'grain')

license.name: CC-BY-4.0 (HF tag)
license.evidence: source images come from the Unsplash Lite dataset; Unsplash terms govern the images (internal use only per configs/datasets.yaml)

datasets.commercial_ml_training: not permitted for FilmLook (Unsplash terms); also not film

datasets.content: 60 image+text rows; no card, no licence
